kinematics: finite deformation: F = I + grad u = R(theta) Ubar Fp, Fp(0) = I in the grain-rotated reference lattice; SVK on Ebar = (Ubar^T Ubar - I)/2 + 2 mu_c a^2, a = (Ubar_21 - Ubar_12)/2; element-mean finite-strain correction on a pointwise quadratic P2 operator
fields_note: Point data (P1, nodal): u, v, dtheta_deg, theta_lattice_deg, theta_dot, T, phi -- the fields differentiated in post-processing. Cell data (P0, one value per triangle, exact solver values at the element-mean deformation): p1-p3 (accumulated slip), slip paths, rhoS, rhoG, kp, wstar, tau_c, tau_1-3 (Mandel resolved shear stress M:s(x)n), Cauchy stress sig_ij = (P F^T/J)_ij with i the force direction, sig_33, referential couple stress m, D_rate, Fp_ij (plastic distortion, reference frame), w_cosserat = (Ubar_21-Ubar_12)/2, J = det F, psi_elastic (SVK + Cosserat energy density per reference area). Cells include the boundary edges (line cells); use triangle cells only. Grain id = cell Label of triangles. Derived in paraview_derived.py: theta0, slip_net, drag_eta, strain measures. For F, theta_lattice_deg uses the grain angle averaged to the nodes. Coordinates and u are referential (Lagrangian); use u to warp. theta_dot in rad/ns, D_rate in GPa/ns, rho in um^-2.
